description: Data Duplication Village at DEF CON 31 explores storage media forensics, hardware reliability telemetry, large-scale drive failure trends, and data preservation.

talks.title: What 10 Years of Drive Stats Data Can Tell Us
talks.teaser: Andy Klein presents a decade of longitudinal Backblaze Drive Stats data, analyzing failure metrics, lifetime telemetry, and reliability trends across enterprise storage drives.
talks.summary:
OSINT and Reconnaissance Techniques

This presentation covers open-source intelligence gathering and passive reconnaissance methodologies. The speaker demonstrates tools and techniques for discovering security-relevant information without direct system interaction, including data mining, web scraping, and information synthesis from public sources.
